Our dreams are becoming a reality!!! We know the old man has flown!!! You've seen the work we've done thus far and it is all due to our volunteers and donations from people around the world. But we want you to know it's not our dream to just refurbish Mr. Douglas and sit it in a museum, we want him to fly!!! This organization was started to refurbish, maintain, and operate Mr. D in all his glory!!! But we need all the help we can get. If you have the ability please follow the link below to make a small one time or monthly donation to to fund Mr. D well into the future!!!

This bird was meant to fly! On November 13, 2022. This historic DC-3, Mister Douglas took to the skies once again! What a beautiful sight and sound to experience. There are only about 100 of these Majestic aircraft flying in the world today, and today we have one more! It's so important that we preserve our history for future generations to enjoy. We are setting up a trust inside The Mr. Douglas Society, Inc. charity. The principal funds of the trust cannot be spent, only the interest or profit from investment can be used by the charity. We are hoping to raise $50,000 By selling these legacy plaques on the jump seats of Mr. Douglas. Your name will forever be apart of the Mr. Douglas flying museum. The Mr. Douglas Society is a 501(c)(3) public charity. All donations are 100% tax deductible. We are also able to receive property. Or items of value that can be sold to benefit the charity. So please include us as on your list of charitable giving. Let’s keep Mr. Douglas flying long after we’re gone.
